findings.label: MhDarkOutlineVariant duplicates MhDarkSurfaceVariant
findings.detail: Both are Color(0xFF3F484A). M3 allows this in dark themes but there is no comment confirming it is intentional. Confirm against the design spec and add a comment if deliberate.

findings.label: No onStatus* tokens in MediHistoryExtendedColors
findings.detail: statusCurrent, statusPast, and statusUnknown have no paired onStatus* tokens. Status badge composables will have to hardcode text colours. Add onStatusCurrent, onStatusPast, onStatusUnknown before the badge UI is built.
